attchmntText: Shreyans Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Shreyans Industries Limited has published its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The company disclosed these results in English and Punjabi newspapers on 14th July 2026. The announcement was issued by Parminder Singh, Company Secretary. The filing was submitted to BSE Limited with code 515016 and National Stock Exchange of India Limited with code SHREYANIND.

attchmntText: Shreyans Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Shreyans Industries Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 13th November 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended 30th September 2026. The company reported a loss before tax of 2,526.65 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026, compared to a loss of 1,344.19 lakhs in the same period last year. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, the loss before tax was 2,470.84 lakhs, compared to a loss of 2,361.12 lakhs in the corresponding previous period. The statutory auditors, SCV & Co. LLP, issued an unmodified opinion on the reviewed financial results. The meeting commenced at 01.00 p.m. and concluded at 02.30 p.m.
